1_hook: Five ocean facts that will make you feel small.
2_water: The ocean holds about ninety-seven percent of all the water on Earth, and covers more than seventy percent of its surface.
3_depth: On average, the ocean is about three thousand six hundred and eighty-two meters deep. That is more than three and a half kilometers of water.
4_trench: Challenger Deep is about ten thousand nine hundred and thirty-five meters deep. Drop Mount Everest in, and its peak would still be about two kilometers underwater.
5_light: There is rarely any significant sunlight below two hundred meters. And below one thousand meters, none at all.
6_map: Only twenty-eight point seven percent of the seafloor has been mapped in high resolution. Explorers have seen less than one thousandth of one percent of the deep seafloor.
